requests.prompt:
IMAGE REQUEST: ONE SINGLE PAINTING. Return exactly one image, nothing else. Generate it now. Do not make a plan, a sheet or several states.

ATTACHED IMAGE
1) The attached picture is the finished painting of Grump Hollow, a woodland area with a pond, from "The Adventures of Tom", a family role-playing game. Nine small paper muffin wrappers are already pasted onto its ground as a guide.

PAINT THIS ONE PICTURE
The exact same painting, same size, same framing, same colors, same light, same brushwork, with ONE change: repaint each of the nine small muffin wrappers so it belongs in the painting. Keep every wrapper exactly where it is and exactly as small as it is in the attached picture: do not move, enlarge, add or remove any. They make a loose trail. The first wrapper is on the stone path just inside the gate, under the green exit board. The rest climb the path and curve into the lower left part of the big muddy clearing. The last one is a little left of the middle of the clearing.

THE WRAPPERS
Each wrapper is a pleated paper muffin liner, cream and pale golden brown, crumpled and flattened, with a few cake crumbs and a smear of mud. Exactly nine, each crumpled a little differently, with crisp pleated edges so each one still reads at a glance. Each lies flat on the ground with a soft painted contact shadow, painted by hand in the same brushwork and warm light as the rest of the picture.

KEEP
Everything else in the picture stays exactly as painted: every tree, path, rock, bench, sign, the pond and the exit board keep their places, sizes and colors. No people, animals or monsters. No new words, letters or numbers.
